row.title: Ultimate Weekend Package
row.description:
Indulge in a delightful stay with our exclusive room offer, which includes a daily buffet breakfast at South Parade. Additionally, enjoy 15% off food and soft beverages (not applicable on alcoholic beverages) during your stay, making every meal a memorable experience.
• Applicable on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, for a minimum stay of 2 nights
• 10% discount on the best available rate
• Daily buffet breakfast at South Parade
• 15% savings on dining throughout your stay

row.title: Lavelle Business Package
row.description:
Enhance your business trip with savings on our bed and breakfast rate, dining and airport transfers. Available from Monday to Friday each business week.
• Buffet breakfast at South Parade
• Round-trip airport transfers, once during the stay
• 15% discount on dining throughout the stay (not applicable on alcoholic beverages)
• 5% discount on the best available rate

set.intro_body: Seasonal packages for every kind of stay on Lavelle Road — whether you are booking early, staying for the weekend or travelling on business.
